payload.note: Exact C6 transverse centered-residual Jacobian checkpoint: the physical squared Jacobian is a 1293-term Laurent polynomial with 951 positive and 342 negative coefficients, so the unprojected positive-coefficient AM-GM proof does not survive output centering. At the dyadic field (1,-1,2,-2,-2,2) log 2 its log-field Hessian has an exact negative order-five principal minor, obstructing translation plus convexity. The vacuum is nevertheless a strict local minimum modulo scale and the unique minimum over all 9331 mean-zero dyadic points in [-3,3]^6. The global Jacobian inequality, its normalized-marginal bridge, and the interacting H^-1 estimate remain open.
